proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING EEO-1 DISCLOSURE
proposals.proponent: The Congregation of Benedictine Sisters, Boerne, Texas
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Home Depot prepare and make available to investors a diversity report with gender and race data by job category, affirmative action summary, and diversity programs description.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws so holders of 10% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote against this shareholder proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING REPORT ON PRISON LABOR IN THE SUPPLY CHAIN
proposals.proponent: NorthStar Asset Management, Inc. Funded Pension Plan
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report to shareholders on the known extent of prison labor usage in the company's supply chain, including audit metrics and risks.
